reviews.text: We brought in Enzo now twice for different types of care. They are so gentle with him as he doesn’t like going to the vet.
Such a kind and caring staff! Very calm and patient when explaining the procedures in layman’s terms. I know my baby is in good hands here.

Dr. Leach is hands down one of the best vets you will ever find! I’ve trusted her with my cats for years. She combines top-tier medical expertise and experience with incredible kindness, and her staff is absolutely wonderful as well.
Dr Leach is amazing! She always takes the time to listen to our concerns and takes exceptional care of our pets! And the hours are great (and they have parking!)

Amazing people. Great service.
Always kind and caring.
The staff is very professional and attentive.  Dr. Leach is the best vet available.  We have been coming here for  30 plus years.

We’ve brought our cats to Beverly Oaks Animal Hospital for regular check-ups, injuries, and end of life, and  have always been  blessed with BOAH’s remarkable, compassionate, and deeply knowledgeable care. With the help of Dr Leach and her amazing staff we’ve had all three live healthy lives into their 20’s. The best.

We brought our boy Philo after a little fight with his brother. He had a mouth injury and Dr. Jellineck, was so kind and offered us many options for care. They also healed him up after an attack by a coyote.Great Doctors great practice.

two years ago I gave a one star review all because of the front office and how rude they are and I’ve always been or I should say one woman in particular and sometime she sits a bad example. But I still have friends that go there and I still recommend this hospital because Dr. Leech and the other veterinarians are wonderful. I wasn’t able to change my other review. I’m giving a very good review here because this is an extremely good hospital again except for one or two people at the front desk. According to my friends, it’s been very good in the last year or so.

I've been coming to Beverly Oaks Animal Hospital for quite a while now and Dr Leach is probably the best feline vet I've ever met she's been so good with my cat whose name is Woogie.... she is the only veterinarian who I will let him see.
Bobby
Amazing!😃Lady was so nice,also great service . …

We’ve had several visits with our cat, this hospital worked with the rescue service we adopted her through and every visit has been exceptional. We and our animal feel very taken care of each time. Making appointments is also very quick and easy and so far they’ve always been able to see us asap, as opposed to other places we use that usually make us wait several days to a week for appointments sometimes. This place is by far our favorite because of the superior quality of service. Thank you for taking care of our animal!
My pug Suki went to this vet for an eye problem. He did a very good surgery in 2025. Very good vet.

Our cat had an aural hematoma: when the outer layer separates from the inner layer, and blood gets trapped. They offered draining vs minor surgery. What I liked about our experience:
-They were able to get him in the same day.
-they didn’t fat shame us
-they didn’t upsell other products or services
- thoroughly explained everything
-cute wallpaper in the waiting room
-the vet tech is sooo sweet. She was walking by our room and like a bloodhound, was able to sniff out that he protest-pooped in the carrier. She took him straight to the back and gave him a bath. He came back wrapped in a blanket, cuddling her.
- surgery went well. He’s 13, so u never know.
- ear healed up despite him removing the cone & bandage within an hour of getting home and while it’s a bit wonky (but it suits his personality)he hasn’t had the problem since.
Thank you Beverly Oaks for your care and service!
I love this place . Everybody who works here is knowledgeable , friendly  and the prices are reasonable .

Hi Honora, 
Thank you for the 5-star review!! It means the world to our whole team. Wish you and your pet all the best - Beverly Oaks Animal Hospital
Hi S A, Thank you for leaving this wonderful review for us!! We are always there for you. Wish you All the Best - Beverly Oaks Animal Hospital
I came here with my last cat Kiki (RIP) and they always did an amazing job and now bring my other two here as well. They are very thorough and kind. I’m grateful to have them as my vet.
Thorough and helpful. Took their time with me and our kitties and gave us treatment and care options.

Beverly Oaks has been my go to for over 20 years.  Dr Wood is thorough, patient and knowledgeable.  He answers questions and takes his time with Squish-e. Lucky to have found such a caring  and attentive veterinarian.

*** THANK YOU TO THE ENTIRE STAFF

Took my bulldog here, entire staff is professional and they take extra care of the animals they are the best for a reason! ***** they should be rated 5Star——anyone who has a dog or cat - I highly recommend them.

Sherman oaks Beverly Oaks Animal Hospital is a full-service veterinary facility located at 14302 Ventura Blvd, Sherman Oaks, CA 91423. They operate as both a general practice and a daytime emergency clinic, open 7 days a week from 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM -

Thanks again! Cheers and blessings

Cynthia
Dr. Leech is so thorough and she cares.😇 I have not been gasp with a vet in the valley in a very long time. I thank Heavens for her. Just sad they are not a 24 hour care vet any longer 🥲 …

We brought in both our dogs, Alfie and Siffy, for check ups and vaccines. It’s alway easy as we have been coming here for over 15 years and the dogs are always calm and happy. The doctors and staff are great and always explain options and costs. They never push anything as they want the owners and animals to be comfortable and have a good experience. We will always bring our dogs here. Thanks for all the help always!
As perfect a Vet experience as there can be. My dog was calm and the Vet was knowledgeable, friendly and very experienced !!
Hi Harry Garlanian, Thank you for leaving this wonderful review for us!! We are always there for you. Wish you All the Best - Beverly Oaks Animal Hospital
Thanks for seeing us on short notice! Really appreciate the weekend hours

i have 3 cats, they have been thorough throughout each and every single one of their exams, and have addressed all of my concerns, including hairballs, they’re very transparent about the price, and yeah, i would recommend this vet to my friend and i always feel so special when they write my pets name on the wall lol

I have been going to Dr. Leach in Beverly Oaks  animal Hospital for at least Two decades
With several of my dogs. She has done an amazing job And her staff is very warm and friendly. Both my dogs are currently 16 years old and doing well and if they have an issue, she always gets them in as needed. Her facility is clean and they always explain things very clearly. I couldn’t recommend them enough!
Great place! Calm and taught us what to do when we had trouble bringing her in. Kind people.

I highly recommend Beverly Oaks Animal Hospital! They have great staff and vets, always incredibly helpful, kind, and understanding. They helped me find what was making my cat sick and were communicating with fellow Dr.s to get to the bottom of it. They really cared for my pet and helped me throughout the process of healing my cat. They are great people, truly!

I have been coming to this vet for so many years. Dr. LEECH & Dr. WOOD are the absolute best. You can immediately tell that they have extensive knowledge in what they do. Thank you for years of help with my dogs Brownie, Pelusa, Mona, Favorite, Peweeta, Peewee, Gordo, and my Cat Chano. 🫶🏻💖

Dr. Leach and her staff have been wonderful in helping me take care of my pup. My daughter referred this Veterinary Office to me because of the great care her cats receive. They are very thorough and compassionate.

The knowledgeable and friendly staff and especially Dr Leach helped my cat Milo with his stomach issues. Dr Leach had performed an emergency surgery for my little small cat 8 years ago who had still born kittens. The surgery was performed in a competent and compassionate matter. I highly recommend Dr Leach and the staff of Beverly Oaks Animal Hospital for any veterinary care you pets may need. -BD
I brought in a neighborhood feral cat that I wanted to adopt.  They were so kind, explained everything and gave me some helpful tips to acclimate him to being an indoor cat.
Always professional and nice. I’ve never had an issue getting in or having a long wait which is great when you have a busy schedule!
I used Beverly Oaks Animal Hospital for about 16 years.  My two doggies love this place, their personal is professional and caring.

Dr Laurie Leach is an amazing vet
She performs almost any surgery and has been our vet for over 34 years!  She is brilliant and compassionate
Best vet for my cat

It's been a long time. I remember what Laura wrote on the card, "they stay with you a lifetime" I think of Ali and the fortune of being with others every day. knowing Sheena, Rudy & Dr. Leach was a warm experience and helped make a difference. all have great communication skills, including Laura.   thanks Carl
DR. Leach saved Danny Rose's life two or tree times and mine once. She is an experienced, knowledgeable vet . The same can be said about all of her staff, front and back.
Very friendly, caring and professional care for my cat.
Excellent vet and extremely friendly!  Very much recommended!!!!  Been bringing my cats there for 15+ years!!!!!!
Top tier veterinary care from great people. I always recommend BOAH.
We are so grateful for all the folks at Beverly Oaks Animal Hospital from the caring, knowledgeable doctors and techs, to the lovely staff who are so supportive.

I've been going to Beverly Oaks Animal Hospital for many years.  I love the staff and the service.  Everyone is very knowledgeable and very warm and friendly.  One of my cats is hard to handle but Dr. Leach and her staff handle him brilliantly with as little stress as possible.  Thanks so much for your wonderful and loving treatment of my most beloved family members.

Dr. Leach and staff are terrific.  I brought in my beautiful cat B for some skin issues.  She is an excellent diagnostician and offers reasonable solutions to issues.   The support staff are caring and efficient.
Everything was great. Dr. Leach, Dr. Woods and all the techs were very helpful and skilled.

Super caring Doctors and staff.
Took care of my 21 year old dog Lola with great care and attention.

Dr. Leach is a talented and caring veterinarian and has been an amazing diagnostician over the years for our cat’s various illnesses/ailments.  We truly appreciate her.  Additionally, the vet techs at Beverly Oaks are gentle, kind and great at what they do!
The best vet clinic I've found in my 28 years in this area.  Dr. Leach is wonderful, efficient, sympathetic, and everything you could ask for in what can be a stress-filled situation.
It has been my emergency hospital and literally has been life saving. Thank you for your great service.

I have been bringing my animals to Beverly Oaks for 25 years. Dr. Leach has been my vet since my first day in the valley. They have always given us the most exceptional care and always shoot straight. It is hard to know because animals can't talk to us about what might be wrong. I have never been excessively tested or overcharged. From day one until the very last day, Beverly Oaks has consistently delivered excellent care to all of my dear ones.
We love it here. All my dogs are under Dr. Leach's care.
Hi ellen lafair, We are grateful that you took the time out to leave us a review. Your feedback is appreciated - Beverly Oaks Animal Hospital

Dr Leach was the only vet who stood by me with so many sick animals that other vets wanted to euthanize. She's the only one out of so many throughout Southern California my family and friends completely trust and we refer anyone to her especially when they are getting different stories from different vets and not sure what to believe. Dr Leach has a bedside manner that surpasses even all of the holistic vets out there. She has helped extend the lives of many seniors, years beyond what many vets stated was possible. She lacks the arrogance that too many have and makes people feel comfortable. She has always gone above and beyond and really truly seems to love what she does even after doing it for so many years when other vets seem to get burned out and greedy. Thank you for staying in this for the long haul Dr Leach. You are beloved by more than you know.

I had an amazing experience with this veterinarian. She took her time, answered all of my questions, and truly listened to my concerns. After trying many other vets who couldn’t figure out why my dog Lux kept having ear pain, she was finally able to diagnose the issue correctly and prescribe the right medication. Lux is already doing so much better thanks to her care. I’m incredibly grateful and highly recommend her to anyone looking for a knowledgeable and compassionate vet.
Bev Oaks Animal Hospital is the BEST!

Wow, that's a tough one - NOT!! Beverly Oaks, Dr Leach and the entire staff ROCK! All of us at Cat Connection could not appreciate you more. We thank you from the bottom of our hearts for taking such great care of our Cats, Kittens and Dogs we've rescued over the years. Happy Holidays to all of you who work so hard to help the Animals!!

Beverly Oaks Animal Hospital has been a lifesaver—Dr. Leach is truly wonderful. After a frustrating experience at VetCo in Burbank, where my appointment was canceled once and then I was quoted thousands in testing with no real answers, Dr. Leach quickly identified that my pet was simply over-grooming and resolved it with a $10 recovery suit from Amazon. The difference in care was night and day: the staff here is kind, honest, and genuinely invested in helping animals rather than pushing unnecessary services. I’m incredibly grateful to have found them and won’t be going anywhere else.

I was fostering a kitten through Kitt Crusaders that had been sick and was being treated there. I picked her up and she did great for several days and then went downhill fast. I rushed her back to Beverly Oaks and they were able to see her right away. Dr Leach was fantastic! She ordered bloodwork and diagnosed her with FIP which is normally fatal but she suggested a protocol for 42 days! and the kitten recovered fully and has been healthy and active since. Dr Leach explained everything fully and patiently answered all of my questions and concerns.
Hi a i, Seeing that you had a 5-Star experience is the best thing we could hope for! Your review means a lot to us. Thank you for choosing Beverly Oaks Animal Hospital
I’ve been taking my animals here for  20 years. Dr. Turner saved my girl’s life back then, and now Dr. Leach and Dr. Levy take great care of my Tuxie boys. Highly recommend!
My feline is still breathing because of this wonderful place

I can’t say enough great things about this vet clinic! They took amazing care of my foster dog who needed extensive surgery and aftercare. They were extremely professional, patient, and compassionate. It was obvious that they have a true love for animals and work closely with rescue cases. I’m extremely grateful for this clinic and their devotion. I would highly recommend them.

I brought my cat in for a urinary blockage. I had never been here before, and it was his second blockage this year. He had been at the ER (Mash) and they were recommending major surgery and charging me insane amounts for unnecessary things. In a desperate attempt to find somewhere my cat could stay overnight and get help (our regular vet doesn’t keep animals overnight) I came here.

Dr. Leach, Dr. Wood, Tony, and the rest of the vet techs were so beyond wonderful. They were extremely communicative (with me and with each other), told me they wanted to try and spare my boy from surgery, and did everything to get him better. He spent three nights and four days with them, and then I got to take him home.

And let me tell you: while my cat is a gentle and loving boy at home, he is a monster at the vet. A complete and total menace. He is terrified and becomes totally uncooperative and even violent. It takes multiple people to wrangle him. The staff here were all SO gentle with him and caring of him, despite this! Special shout out to Tony who showed me how to give my cat  subcutaneous injections before I took him home.

The staff let me visit for long periods each day, knowing how important that was to keep my cat calm. They always treated him and me with so much kindness and respect.

Additionally, the front desk was so patient with me and very quick to respond. They assured me it was okay to call any time and never made me feel like a burden.

Thank you all so, so much!!

My beloved kitty, Yoda, has an ear issue that I have looked to Dr. leach for guidance on treatment or comfort. My experience with her care in other pets I had had been exceptional and I trust her medical e pertinent and her honesty.

My family has been coming to Beverly Oaks Animal Hospital and Dr Leach for over 25 years and 7 dogs ranging from vaccines and annual physicals to emergency care with never a problem or complaint to register. The staff at Beverly Oaks is uniformly professional, compassionate and highly experienced and knowledgeable about seemingly every aspect of animal care from puppyhood to the sad times we had to say goodbye to a beloved pet.

A special shout out to Cathy at revenge t desk and the scheduling team for always making us feel welcome and taken care of.

Dr. Leach is an exceptional veterinarian. She has taken care of our dogs for 16 years and has provided excellent medical care that has prolonged their quality of life. Cathy and the front office has always been warm and welcoming. The vet techs are compassionate and loving. A 5 star establishment.
I have been going to the Beverly Oaks Animal Hospital for over 30 years. Dr. Leach is the best and so caring when treating our little pet kids. I'm very lucky to have her as a part of my family.

We've been coming to Beverly Oaks for 10+ years. I wouldn't trust any other docs with my doxies. They are knowledgeable, forthcoming, honest, and straightforward. They provide a pre-bill so ypu know exactly what to expect before proceeding with care. Their techs are empathetic and caring and though it may take some time to be seen (my only complaint), I know it's because they are giving their time to other pet parents and patients.
Everyone at Beverly Oaks is wonderful! The front desk, techs and Dr. Leach take care of my senior dog like she was one of their own! I would never go anywhere else.

Dr. Leach and staff are wonderful. Dr. Leach is caring, gentle, experienced, and knowledgeable. I needed to take my dog to a cardiologist due to an emergency, and Dr. Leach called me to see how my dog was doing. Ironically, I could barely get a hold of the cardiologist at the larger chain veterinarian office. Her technicians are kind and gentle, and my animals feel comfortable with them. Dr. Leach's front office staff is very accommodating and fits my dog in for appointments when needed. They also have a fabulous dental technician and the outcomes are great. Please do not hesitate to schedule an appointment. Thank you Dr. Leach and Staff!!
Fast service, low in cost ( 2011) .

My 4 year old min pin Brooklyn had been limping on and off for several months and was diagnosed with a joint problem in her rear leg called luxating patella.  I had never heard of this, but apparently it's very common in small breed dogs …

Dr. Leach is incredible. She caught things that a previous vet had missed, took all of our concerns seriously, and loaded us up with a comprehensive care plan. I would absolutely recommend this office!

Don't bring medium to large dogs here. The vet that attended us did not know how to handle my 45 lb dog. I will NEVER EVER come back here. The only reason I went there is because I was new to the area. I've gone to different vets throughout …

They killed my first ever pet. The vet said my sweet kitty (who was overall not bad and was brought in for an unrelated checkup) had diabetes and needed daily insulin shots. He died at home in pain after many hours of fighting for his life …

I have always really appreciated the staff at Beverly Oaks and have been bringing my cats here for many years now. A lot of vets price gauge and do so much testing on your pet that any owner would say yes to when in fear of something being …

My son Evan and now me go to Beverly Oaks with our female Siberian husky. She is 12 yrs now!! Took her in 3 days ago. Put her on an antibiotic that has in 3 days made a difference in an aggravated sore on her leg. I appreciate her listening to how I felt about issues !!! 🙏Dr Leech Fondly Michele Shapiro 10/1625 …
Hi Jordan Byers, your review means a lot to us. Thank you for the 5 Star review and thank you for choosing Beverly Oaks Animal Hospital
